scope: Complete skills subtree plus root LICENSE.md; root package.json was read only in temporary audit cache, not vendored.
method: Static YAML parsing, duplicate-key detection, Markdown/resource path checks, command-pattern review, and full-file SHA-256 plus Git blob SHA-1 verification. No upstream code executed.

validation.nameConstraints: All names are 1-64 lowercase ASCII alphanumeric/hyphen characters, without leading/trailing/repeated hyphens, and match their containing directory.
validation.descriptions: All parsed descriptions are nonempty strings of at most 1024 characters.

version.guidance: Detect the target project's actual Phaser version from its manifest and lockfile. Do not infer target compatibility from upstream authoring baselines, and do not upgrade an existing project without a migration request. Source-map paths under src/ and docs/ refer to the upstream Phaser repository, which is intentionally not included beyond skills/.

license.note: Retain the copyright and license notice in redistribution. GitHub reported the pinned commit unsigned; hashes verify consistency with GitHub's pinned source, not independent authorship.

installationExample.action: Instructional migration checklist only; not executed and not permission to install or upgrade.

auditOnlyRootPackage.action: Not included in vendored runtime; no scripts were run.

limitations: Static audit and targeted manual review are not an exhaustive semantic or security proof.
No engine builds, dependency installation, upstream tests, or external publication were performed.
External URLs and engine-version API accuracy were not exhaustively validated.
Known upstream path errors are recorded additively; original source bytes remain unchanged.
